bibliographic.title: The Flightless
bibliographic.author: Polaris Storm
bibliographic.description:
Fall into your destiny, Flightless...

The Flightless is an dark, psychological interactive fiction game about a teenager named Abby who discovers a strange world after killing themself... and the destruction of parts of themself that follows.

CONTENT WARNING: Suicide, Violence, Mental Health Theming, Domestic Violence, Child Abuse, Transphobia. There is no sexual content in this game, the age-gate is due to how graphically these themes are depicted.

Made for TriGameDev's Monthly Game Jam #5! The theme was "Destruction." This was made in ~30 hours, please tell me if anything's wonky.
